name: Mali (ITS, IRF, IRVM)
kernel_parts_used: percentage family reduction and two-point reduction (local)

sources: Code général des impôts du Mali, DGI online code https://www.dgi.gouv.ml/CGI/ (fetched 2026-11-20; document metadata 2017-08-23; latest notes Loi n° 2016-10, LF 2012/2013)
DGI annual activity reports 2024 and 2025 (dgi.gouv.ml, scanned; OCR): no ITS change mentioned
scale: 3494130 XOF (threshold of the top (37 %) annual ITS band)
unsupported: INPS / AMO rates from the INPS guide of 2013 (official secondary; later changes not checked)

headline: Mali built from the DGI's online CGI, a 2017 consolidation (LF 2018-2025 not reached): annual ITS 0-37 % on wages and pensions, a family reduction of 10 % (married) + 2,5 % per child of the tax, and a two-point cut of the average rate (art. 12-A).

w5_pattern_a.added: INPS assurance vieillesse 3,6 % and AMO 3,06 % of all remuneration, reported; the 3,6 % pension retention deducted (CGI art. 7 a), limit 4 %)
w5_pattern_a.provision: INPS "Guide du cotisant" (PDF of 10 August 2013, Internet Archive capture 2021-09-23): AMO salarié 3,06 %, vieillesse salarié 3,6 %; Code de prévoyance sociale art. 187 (base); official secondary; CGI art. 7 a)
w5_pattern_a.switch: "w5Contrib": false restores the pre-W5 outputs (0 / 300 random households differ)

d9_review.cause: EITD MLI 2020 = art. 10 barème on gross pay; omits CGI art. 7 a) (INPS 3,6 % deducted) and arts. 12-A/12-B (two-point reduction)
